projects.title: Ticket Matcher
projects.desc: A decision-support tool for IT service desk tickets. It recommends the next action and presents the resolved tickets on which the recommendation is based.
highlights: Retrieves similar past tickets, with their sources, using a fine-tuned BGE-large encoder (tm-res2, 335M parameters)
Applies a decision layer that recommends a fix, escalation, or the gathering of further detail
Trained on a decade of tickets and evaluated on later tickets that were not seen in training
projects.status: Used by the IT service desk, University of Newcastle

projects.title: Guarded Browser Assistant
projects.desc: A browser extension for Chrome and Edge that completes lengthy web forms from a request held in another system. It follows written rules and does not use AI.
highlights: 171 written, versioned service desk rules, verified by 519 automated tests
A continuous integration gate on every change: type checking, tests, build and privacy scan
Fail-closed by design: every value is read back, processing halts on any unexpected condition, and the officer always performs the final submission
projects.status: Used by the IT service desk, University of Newcastle

projects.title: ZoomMate Side Panel
projects.desc: A Chrome extension that opens ZoomMate in the browser side panel beside any web page. The interface was redesigned for a narrow panel rather than reduced from the full ZoomMate application.
highlights: Presents only the chat box and responses; project settings, the carousel, quick-action chips and suggestions are hidden
Home page: the greeting is centred and the chat box is fixed at the bottom
Project and agent pages: the title is placed at the top, a scrollable chat history in the middle and the chat box at the bottom
The menu opens on load and closes once a project or agent is selected, allowing the chat the full width of the panel
projects.status: Used across Digital Technology Solutions, University of Newcastle

projects.title: Deskmate
projects.tag: AI agent · Service desk ticket helper powered by ZoomMate
projects.desc: A service desk ticket assistant powered by Zoom's ZoomMate. It provides service desk officers with ticket guidance directly within Zoom chat.
highlights: Recommends the next action, the knowledge article to consult and the team to which the ticket should be escalated
Supplies cited resolution steps and similar past tickets with each recommendation
Draws on a curated knowledge base of the desk's articles and resolved tickets, comprising over 100 context files, under strict answer instructions
Advisory only: it does not send or alter anything within a ticket
projects.status: Used by the IT service desk, University of Newcastle

projects.title: Phantom Signal
projects.desc: MSc capstone project with Tomago Aluminium: an authorised, LLM-driven phishing simulation that measured an industrial organisation's exposure to AI-generated social engineering.
highlights: Collected open-source intelligence with BeautifulSoup and compiled it into staff persona profiles
Fine-tuned Gemma 3 12B to generate targeted phishing emails
The simulated emails bypassed email filtering and drew recipient engagement; mitigation recommendations were delivered

projects.title: Rock Detection Pipeline
projects.desc: A computer vision pipeline that detects rocks on coal conveyor belts under variable lighting, occlusion and high belt speed.
highlights: YOLOv7 object detection tuned for industrial conditions
OpenCV preprocessing to compensate for lighting variation
End-to-end Python pipeline from image input to detection output

projects.title: Intelligent Library Assistant
projects.desc: An LLM assistant that answers university library enquiries using retrieval over library content.
highlights: Retrieval-augmented generation over library content
Fine-tuned gpt-oss-20b, combined with prompt engineering
Python implementation of the complete chat flow

research.intro: Applied research in natural language processing, security and machine learning: building models that are rigorously evaluated rather than merely trained.

current.title: Clinical Bias Detection in Discharge Summaries
current.desc: Note-level detection of clinician bias (explicit, implicit, none) in MIMIC-III v1.4 discharge summaries, using 9,000 human-labelled notes, patient-grouped splits and a frozen 1,500-note test set. Compares a lexicon baseline and TF-IDF with long-context clinical encoders (BioClinical ModernBERT, Clinical-Longformer, Clinical-BigBird) and QLoRA-fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B, with a keyword-masking test, paired bootstrap intervals and calibration analysis. Results will be published following peer review.
